module RAM #(
    parameter WIDTH = 6,
    parameter DEPTH = 8
) (
    input clk,
    input rst_n,
    input write_en,
    input [$clog2(DEPTH)-1:0] write_addr,
    input [WIDTH-1:0] write_data,
    input read_en,
    input [$clog2(DEPTH)-1:0] read_addr,
    output reg [WIDTH-1:0] read_data
);

    
    reg [WIDTH-1:0] RAM [0:DEPTH-1];

    
    integer i;
    always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
        if (!rst_n) begin
            
            for (i = 0;
 i < DEPTH;
 i = i + 1) begin
                RAM[i] <= {WIDTH{1'b0}};
            end
        end
        else if (write_en) begin
            RAM[write_addr] <= write_data;
        end
    end

        if (!rst_n) begin
            read_data <= {WIDTH{1'b0}};
        end
        else begin
            if (read_en) begin
                read_data <= RAM[read_addr];
            end
            else begin
                read_data <= {WIDTH{1'b0}};
            end
        end
    end

);

                wave <= 0;
            end

    end
end

module sequence_detector (
    input clk,
    input reset_n,
    input data_in,
    output reg sequence_detected
);


localparam [2:0] IDLE = 3'b000,
                 S1   = 3'b001,
                 S2   = 3'b010,
                 S3   = 3'b011,
                 S4   = 3'b100;

reg [2:0] current_state, next_state;


always @(posedge clk or negedge reset_n) begin
    if (!reset_n) begin
        current_state <= IDLE;
    end
    else begin
        current_state <= next_state;
    end
end


always @(*) begin
    case (current_state)
        IDLE: begin
            next_state = data_in ? S1 : IDLE;
        end
        S1: begin
            next_state = data_in ? S1 : S2;
        end
        S2: begin
            next_state = data_in ? S1 : S3;
        end
        S3: begin
            next_state = data_in ? S4 : IDLE;
        end
        S4: begin
            next_state = IDLE;
        end
        default: next_state = IDLE;
    endcase
end


always @(*) begin
    sequence_detected = (current_state == S4);
end

endmodule

    input rst_n,
    output reg [63:0] Q
);

always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
        Q <= 64'b0;
    end else begin
        if (Q[0] == 0) begin
            Q <= {1'b1, Q[63:1]};
        end else begin
            Q <= {1'b0, Q[63:1]};
        end
    end
end

endmodule

module RAM (
    input clk,
    input rst_n,
    input write_en,
    input [2:0] write_addr,
    input [5:0] write_data,
    input read_en,
    input [2:0] read_addr,
    output reg [5:0] read_data
);
    
    reg [5:0] RAM [0:7];

    
    always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
        if (!rst_n) begin
            
            integer i;
            for (i = 0;
 i < 8;
 i = i + 1) begin
                RAM[i] <= 6'b0;
            end
        end
        else if (write_en) begin
            
            RAM[write_addr] <= write_data;
        end
    end

    
    always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
        if (!rst_n) begin
            
            read_data <= 6'b0;
        end
        else begin
            
            if (read_en) begin
                read_data <= RAM[read_addr];
            end
            else begin
                
                read_data <= 6'b0;
            end
        end
    end

endmodule

module multi_8bit (
    input [7:0] A,
    input [7:0] B,
    output [15:0] product
);
    wire [15:0] A_extended = {8'b0, A};

    assign product = 
        (B[0] ? (A_extended << 0) : 16'd0) +
        (B[1] ? (A_extended << 1) : 16'd0) +
        (B[2] ? (A_extended << 2) : 16'd0) +
        (B[3] ? (A_extended << 3) : 16'd0) +
        (B[4] ? (A_extended << 4) : 16'd0) +
        (B[5] ? (A_extended << 5) : 16'd0) +
        (B[6] ? (A_extended << 6) : 16'd0) +
        (B[7] ? (A_extended << 7) : 16'd0);

endmodule
